default: 😀 Your face makes music!
🔊 Turn your sound up!
📷 Sit where the camera can see you.
😮 Open your mouth to make a sound!
😱 Open it BIG to make it LOUD!
↕️ Move your head to find new notes!
⭐ Copy the face on screen to win points!
🎯 Each face wins points once. Collect them all!
🙈 Too tricky? Skip it and keep playing!
🐢 No rush! Go slow and have fun.
🥁 Want drums? Turn on Beats!
🎛️ Open Drum Pattern to pick a new beat!
🙌 Turn on Performance and the drums copy YOU!
🤖 Turn Performance off and the drums play by themselves!
😀 Your face makes music!
🔊 Turn your sound up!
📷 Sit where the camera can see you.
😮 Open your mouth to make a sound!
😱 Open it BIG to make it LOUD!
↕️ Move your head to find new notes!
😊 ➡️ 😯 Try a smile, then an Ooh face!
🎶 Found a fun sound? Play it again!
⭐ Copy the face on screen to win points!
⏳ Hold the face still for a moment.
👫 Playing with friends? Everyone wins points!
🎯 Each face wins points once. Collect them all!
🔁 Same face again? Your friend needs a turn!
🙈 Too tricky? Skip it and keep playing!
🐢 No rush! Go slow and have fun.
🥁 Want drums? Turn on Beats!
👂 Play along with the drums, or stop and listen.
🎛️ Open Drum Pattern to pick a new beat!
🙌 Turn on Performance and the drums copy YOU!
📈 Crescendo means getting louder and louder! Try Crescendo Build!
🪘 A drum roll is lots of fast hits: brrrrrr! Try Snare Roll Build!
🤩 Open your mouth wide for BIG drum hits!
🤖 Turn Performance off and the drums play by themselves!
🌉 A bridge is a surprise middle part of a song. Try Bridge Break!
🔇 A breakdown goes quiet, then the music comes back. Try Breakdown & Return!
💥 A drop is when the music crashes back in. Try Drop & Impact for a BIG BOOM!
👑 With friends, the drums follow the main player.
🙆 Move your head for extra drum rolls!
⚡ Rapid Hits adds super fast drums!
🔀 You can change the Drum Pattern any time!
📱 Scan the QR code (top right) to play on another device!
